project-continuity-modules.role: Execution continuity: tasks, checkpoints, immutable push receipts, required PR gates.

content-generation-modules.role: Narrative and styling authority: writing routing, human-sounding writing, output naming, visual direction, image generation.

agent-custom-setup.role: Install surface: hot-load FULL PCM + FULL CGM + OIO plus the coordination runtime.

observational-issue-ops.role: Issue-log ticketing system: the canonical issue form, the filer stamp, and its triage.

agent-stack-train.role: The stack release: PCM, CGM, ACS and OIO at one commit of this repository. A one-checkout adopter installs from it and pins it alone.

adoption_rule: This file records the certified versions of project-continuity-modules, content-generation-modules, agent-custom-setup, and observational-issue-ops. The four live in this one repository and move together at one commit, so none of them pins another. An adopter follows this file through its stack-manifest.json: a pin that copies an older version or commit than the one recorded here fails scripts/check_manifest.py.
note: Nothing rewrites this file automatically; change it in a pull request. recorded_at changes only when a certified entry or this rule changes.
